scope: Lemma 5.2 supporting off-cone reduction only: six theorem exports in two supplied modules

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ {A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ} {U : ℝ} {u : Fin 4 → ℤ},
  u ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.offConeFrequencies A U ↔
    0 < QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u ∧
      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u ≤ U ∧
        QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integralQuadraticValue A.adjugate u ≠ 0

∀ (N : ℕ)
  (ξ : (p : ℕ) → Nat.Prime p → ¬p ∣ N → (Fin 4 → ZMod p) → ℂ) (q : ℕ) [inst : NeZero q] (hqN : q.Coprime N)
  (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (u : Fin 4 → ℤ) (X : ℝ),
  ∑ c ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.poissonModuliBelow X,
      ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.sourceMixedCompleteSum N ξ q hqN (↑c) A u‖ / ↑↑c ^ 3 ≤
    ∑ d ∈ q.divisors,
      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.modulusNormSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.extendPrimeWeights N ξ) q d A u X
checked_exports.scope: All positive c in the strict cutoff occur in their gcd class in the inclusive modulus sums of Lemma 3.6. Enlarging the cutoff at an integer endpoint is harmless.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ),
  ∃ M,
    0 < M ∧
      ∀ (U : ℝ),
        0 < U →
          ∀ (u : Fin 4 → ℤ),
            QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u ≤ U →
              |↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integralQuadraticValue A.adjugate u)| ≤ M * U ^ 2
checked_exports.scope: The integral dual quadratic polynomial is uniformly O(U²) on the ball.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ {A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ}
  {weights : Set (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.RealVector4 → ℂ)} {η : ℝ},
  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.ScaledFrequencyIntegralBound
      (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.realQuadraticValue (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℝ))) weights η →
    ∃ J,
      0 < J ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ) (ξ : (p : ℕ) → Nat.Prime p → ¬p ∣ N → (Fin 4 → ZMod p) → ℂ) (q : ℕ) [inst : NeZero q]
          (hqN : q.Coprime N) (B X : ℝ),
          1 ≤ B →
            ∀ w ∈ weights,
              have U := √↑q * B ^ η;
              ‖QuaternaryQuadraticForms.sourceBoundedOffConeSum N ξ q hqN A w X (B / √↑q) U‖ ≤
                J * ↑q / B * B ^ (3 * η) *
                  ∑ d ∈ q.divisors,
                    ∑ u ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.offConeFrequencies A U,
                      QuaternaryQuadraticForms.modulusNormSum (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.extendPrimeWeights N ξ) q d A u
                          X /
                        QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integerEuclideanNorm u
checked_exports.scope: Apply (5.5) to every summand and regroup the nonnegative terms by gcd.

checked_exports.actual_type:
∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (r₀ η : ℝ),
  1 ≤ r₀ →
    0 < η →
      η ≤ 1 / 4 →
        ∃ L,
          0 < L ∧
            ∀ (B q : ℝ),
              1 ≤ B →
                1 ≤ q →
                  ∀ u ∈ QuaternaryQuadraticForms.offConeFrequencies A (√q * B ^ η),
                    (r₀ * (B / √q) * |↑(QuaternaryQuadraticForms.integralQuadraticValue A.adjugate u)|) ^ η ≤
                      L * (B * q) ^ (2 * η)
checked_exports.scope: The growth of the integral dual form at all the off-cone frequencies is absorbed uniformly into the divisor-epsilon factor in Lemma 3.6.
The two terms in Lemma 3.11, including the divisibility factor d², contribute at most 2 q³ B^(3η) for each factorization q=d e.
